title: Semiflows deforming automorphisms groups
summary: In this short note, we prove that, for any pair of finite groups $G$ and $H$, there exist a finite $T_0$-space $X$ and a semiflow $\varphi\colon [0,\infty)\times X\to X$ such that $\operatorname{Aut}(X)\cong G$, whereas $\operatorname{Aut}(\varphi_t(X))\cong H$ for every $t>0$. Thus, the symmetry group of a finite $T_0$-space and those of all its positive-time images can be prescribed independently.
